school.school_name: 上尾中央看護専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Verify the official-index disclosure site finds the yearless confirmation-form PDF without treating the prefecture index itself as PDF fiscal-year evidence.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Open the admission support page and inspect the anchor labeled 確認申請.
Classify it as a target PDF candidate that needs operator review because the URL, anchor, and PDF body do not prove FY2026.

reusable_rules: Keep anchors labeled 確認申請 as strong target-form candidates even when the link text omits the fiscal year.
Use prefecture_aggregator disclosure URLs as crawl/source evidence, not as a replacement for PDF/link fiscal-year evidence.
When a target-form PDF has no FY2026 evidence, emit needs_operator_review with the verified direct PDF URL.
anti_patterns: Do not auto-accept a yearless confirmation-form candidate from any source without its own FY evidence.
Do not discard the PDF as non-target only because the surrounding support page also links many news/common PDFs.
Do not infer FY2026 from the current crawl date or from a current prefecture index.

evidence.notes: Windows v333 Saitama 50-site replay records this target-form PDF as target_fiscal_year_not_detected. Earlier v332/v150-era behavior accepted it with detected_fiscal_year empty and year_evidence=prefecture_index_current_year, but that was a false-positive strict-year success.
